description: Per-exercise custom rest time golden cases run by Android ExerciseRestTimeStoreTest and iOS ExerciseRestTimeTests. A custom rest is a device-local number of seconds pinned to an exercise identity (the friend-ghost key). normalized is the value kept for a stored input, or null when there is no custom rest: a missing or non-positive value is no custom rest, any other value is clamped to minSeconds..maxSeconds (not rounded to the step; the picker moves in stepSeconds). effectiveSeconds is the rest actually started after a set: the normalized custom value when there is one, else defaultSeconds (the unchanged role-based rest). All of it stays inside the active-rest limits 5..1800. usableIdentityKeys / unusableIdentityKeys use the exercise-cue identity rules: a key that is blank, holds a control character, or is `custom:` with no name after it gets no custom rest.
